## [0.43.0] - 2026-10-14

Nothing to read before updating: this release adds a **Start at login**
setting, lets MCP agents read a GraphQL endpoint's schema, and remembers full
screen across launches.

### Added

- **Start at login.** A new switch in Settings > General opens Vayu when you
  sign in, on Windows, macOS and Linux. It shows what the system will
  actually do, so turning Vayu off in Task Manager or System Settings turns
  the switch off too. On Windows, Vayu also reopens if it was running when
  Windows restarted to install updates.
- **Agents can read a GraphQL schema.** The new `get_graphql_schema` MCP tool
  fetches a request's GraphQL schema the way a send would, with its
  variables and auth, and only from hosts the agent is allowed to reach. A
  **Copy for agent** button beside the operation picker copies a reference to
  the selected operation.

### Fixed

- A window closed in full screen reopens in full screen, not as an ordinary
  window the size of the screen.
- Internal: the scripting engine's source split into smaller files, and
  documentation kept in step with all of the above.
